verdicts.reason: A reads left to right (bottle, quote, attribution/logo, CTA) and the CTA is clear. But the quote, which is the headline, is set at about 6px and is barely readable. The large quote mark floats far above it, the attribution sits apart from the quote at top right, and the bottle and its circle are cropped against the left edge. B breaks the design apart: the quote is wrapped into three cramped lines at left, and the quote mark sits after the quote and the bottle instead of before it. The peach circle is cut off at right with no bottle in it. The attribution is tiny low-contrast text tucked next to the CTA, which leaves the reading order jumbled.
